newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch money rates steady in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Dutch money rates steady in quiet trade.

text.p: Guilder rates held steady in quiet trade on Monday, with the upcoming Friday expiry of money market cash reserve posing few problems, dealers said.
Call money was quoted fractionally up at 3.12 percent bid from 3.06 percent last Friday but volumes were tiny, they said.

Under the cash reserve arrangement, money market players are required to maintain a minimum reserve at the central bank. At times its expiry can result in a last-minute liquidity shortage, but this was currently not a factor, traders said.
The guilder held up against the mark, quoting at 112.57 per 100 marks compared with Friday's 112.58 fixing.
